description: Na₅Y(CO₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.76 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.60 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.69 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.68 Å. Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.61 Å. There are four inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.28 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, two equivalent Y, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
